name: Babel Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Crypto Financial Services Provider Babel Finance Suspends Customer Withdrawals due to crypto market turmoil. In July, documents revealed that Babel Finance lost more than $280 million in bitcoin (BTC) and ether (ETH) as its proprietary trading failure. Specifically, it lost around 8,000 BTC and 56,000 ETH in June after facing liquidation due to a severe market downturn.
